absent-from-2014.answer: 2014 line 3039 differs only in the NOTE ('may optionally' for 2002's 'can optionally'), which states no requirement. Re-read against §2002:7.2.2 SR9: IMP reserved, its syntax implementor-defined if defined; unchanged.

behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior CompileTimeArithmeticImplementorDefined, src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Expressions/CompileTimeArithmetic.cs) selects the arithmetic mode for compile-time arithmetic expressions in directives and constant entries; §2002:7.2.2 SR9 involves no expression, so the switch cannot reach it. Its behaviour at --std 2002 is shown: d_imp.cob re-run now at 2002 refuses >>IMP (rc 65, COBOL0001), and pb1366 shows IMP reserved (COBOL2650) at 2002.
